compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
(Infrastructure task — DD ownership is implicit via the agent-modification task that depends on this RED test. The four contract points this test asserts correspond 1:1 to dd-1..dd-4, satisfied by the UPDATE agent task.)

## Description

Create the RED test script and supporting fixtures that lock the contract for the remediation_context input on dso:story-decomposer. The test must FAIL on the current agent file (no DELTA OUTPUT MODE block yet) and PASS after the agent task lands.

Files to create:
- tests/scripts/test-story-decomposer-remediation.sh — bash test using tests/lib/assert.sh; four scenarios mirroring tests/scripts/test-implementation-plan-proposals.sh (awk-scoped section extraction so assertions cannot match pre-existing prose elsewhere in the agent file).
- tests/fixtures/story-decomposer/remediation-context-sample.json — sample payload with absolute reviewer-artifact paths and target_story_ids.
- tests/fixtures/story-decomposer/reviewer-artifact-sample.md — sample reviewer artifact containing a finding with a target_story_id.

The four test scenarios:
1. test_delta_output_mode_section_exists — awk-scope to the DELTA OUTPUT MODE section; assert the literal token `=== DELTA OUTPUT MODE ===` is present.
2. test_evidence_read_gate_required — awk-scope to the section; assert the literal prefix `EVIDENCE FROM` and an instruction phrase like `Read each absolute` or `pre-generation Read`.
3. test_target_story_id_filter_declared — awk-scope to the section; assert `target_story_id` and a filtering directive (e.g., `emit only`, `absent from output`, `not in that set`).
4. test_backward_compat_default — assert the Inputs section names `remediation_context` AND marks it optional; assert pre-change output shape (`story_drafts` field heading still present).

Follow the pattern in tests/scripts/test-implementation-plan-proposals.sh verbatim for awk section-scoping and assert.sh usage. The script must `set -uo pipefail`, source tests/lib/assert.sh, end with `print_summary`. Make it executable.

## TDD Test Spec

Given the unmodified plugins/dso/agents/story-decomposer.md (no DELTA OUTPUT MODE section); When bash tests/scripts/test-story-decomposer-remediation.sh runs; Then the script exits non-zero and emits four FAIL: lines.

## File Impact

| Source | Action |
|--------|--------|
| tests/scripts/test-story-decomposer-remediation.sh | Create |
| tests/fixtures/story-decomposer/remediation-context-sample.json | Create |
| tests/fixtures/story-decomposer/reviewer-artifact-sample.md | Create |

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Test script exists at expected path
  Verify: test -f tests/scripts/test-story-decomposer-remediation.sh
- [ ] Test script is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-story-decomposer-remediation.sh
- [ ] Test script contains exactly the four scenario functions by name
  Verify: for fn in test_delta_output_mode_section_exists test_evidence_read_gate_required test_target_story_id_filter_declared test_backward_compat_default; do grep -q "^${fn}()" tests/scripts/test-story-decomposer-remediation.sh || exit 1; done
- [ ] Running the new test against unmodified agent file returns non-zero (RED)
  Verify: { bash tests/scripts/test-story-decomposer-remediation.sh; test $? -ne 0; }
- [ ] Test is behavioral (awk-scoped grep against actual agent file content)
  Verify: grep -qE 'awk .*DELTA OUTPUT MODE|awk .*story-decomposer' tests/scripts/test-story-decomposer-remediation.sh
- [ ] Remediation-context fixture is valid JSON
  Verify: test -f tests/fixtures/story-decomposer/remediation-context-sample.json && python3 -c 'import json; json.load(open("tests/fixtures/story-decomposer/remediation-context-sample.json"))'
- [ ] Reviewer-artifact fixture exists and references target_story_id
  Verify: test -f tests/fixtures/story-decomposer/reviewer-artifact-sample.md && grep -q 'target_story_id' tests/fixtures/story-decomposer/reviewer-artifact-sample.md
- [ ] `.test-index` updated with RED markers for the four test functions
  Verify: grep -q 'test-story-decomposer-remediation' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
